meaning: Reviewed annual display-name and abbreviation corrections. Raw provider captures remain unchanged. These do not change team identity or division classification.

corrections.note: The prior name was retired before the 2020 season. ESPN's 2019 listing incorrectly uses the later Commanders name.
Washington Football Team was replaced by Commanders in February 2022. The July 2020 announcement establishes its adoption for the 2020 season.
ESPN abbreviates the 1988-2002 Charlotte Hornets as CHA, the code the Bobcats used from 2004. Basketball Reference lists these seasons as CHH.
ESPN gives the city code NO. Basketball Reference lists the New Orleans Hornets seasons as NOH.
ESPN shortens the name to NO/Oklahoma City Hornets, with a stray line break in 2005-06. Basketball Reference gives the full name and NOK for the two seasons played partly in Oklahoma City.
ESPN gives the city code NO. Basketball Reference lists the New Orleans Hornets seasons as NOH; the Pelicans name and NOP begin in 2013-14.
ESPN gives the state code NJ. Basketball Reference lists the New Jersey Nets seasons as NJN.
